t_advice_summary_textbox.text: To alternate between knomes to check to see which one gives you more points.

vb_textbox.text: Hi there, this is such a simply yet fun game! All i could advice you is try change between knomes at the very start of the game to recognise the pattern in which knome is giving you the highest mushrooms for points. Although, the pattern for the knomes does change so be careful as you now need to figure out the new pattern to gain the most points from the ever changing knomes. Equally, the colours of the knomes change around on each game. Remember to recognise which colour is giving you highest points. If this changes click the opposite one. I hope this helps! enjoy this fantastic little game! and i hope you can make the right decisions.... Decisions...Decisions... Your Score Depend On It! :) So don't delay and play today! Thank you... Nicola xx
